real: Fed says it will soon start raising interest rates
anon: The central bank says it will soon start raising rates
note: Statement 2pm ET; Fed said it would soon be appropriate to raise the rate. Market closed slightly down after a wide intraday swing.

real: US inflation hits 7.5%, the highest in 40 years
anon: Prices are rising faster than they have for many years
note: January CPI, 12-month rise 7.5%, released 8:30am ET.

real: Over the holiday, Russia sends troops into east Ukraine
anon: Over the holiday, a big power sends troops next door
note: Putin recognised the two breakaway regions and ordered troops in on the evening of Mon 21 Feb (US Presidents Day, markets closed), so this goes on Tue 22 Feb.

real: Russia invades Ukraine
anon: A major power invades its neighbour
note: Invasion began before the US open. Stocks fell sharply early, then recovered to close up on the day.

real: Over the weekend, West moves to freeze Russia's reserves
anon: Over the weekend, allies move to freeze a rival's cash
note: Allies announced the step on Sat 26 Feb; US Treasury formal prohibition on transactions with the central bank issued Mon 28 Feb.

real: Shares fall as oil surges on fears of a Russian cutoff
anon: Shares fall as fuel prices surge on supply cutoff fears
note: EIA daily WTI spot series shows the spike on 7 Mar. Close -2.95% in file. US ban on Russian oil imports was announced the next day, 8 Mar.

real: Fed raises interest rates for the first time since 2018
anon: Central bank lifts rates for the first time in years
note: Quarter-point rise, first since Dec 2018. Market rose on the day.

real: Powell says a half-point rate rise is on the table
anon: Central bank chief says a bigger rate rise is possible
note: IMF panel, Thu 21 Apr: "50 basis points will be on the table for the May meeting". IMF media centre page carries the quote; Fed transcript not located.

real: US economy shrank in the first quarter, early data show
anon: The economy shrank in the first three months of the year
note: Advance estimate: GDP -1.4% annualised, released 8:30am ET. Stocks rose on the day.

real: After the close, Amazon posts a loss and shares sink
anon: After the close, a huge online shop posts a loss
note: Results released Thu 28 Apr after the close; shares fell sharply on Fri 29 Apr. Check wording of the quarterly loss against the release.

real: Fed raises rates half a point, rules out a bigger step
anon: Central bank doubles the size of its rate rise
note: First half-point rise since 2000. At the press conference Powell said a 0.75 rise was not being actively considered. Stocks rose on the day.

real: Target says soaring costs are cutting into its profit
anon: A big store chain says soaring costs are cutting profit
note: Q1 results before the open on Wed 18 May; Walmart had warned a day earlier.

real: US inflation hits 8.6%, the highest in 40 years
anon: Prices rise even faster, the quickest pace in decades
note: May CPI, 12-month rise 8.6%.

real: Stocks enter a bear market, over 20% below the peak
anon: Stocks fall more than a fifth from their peak
note: Computed from file: close 3749.63 vs peak close 4796.56 is 21.8% lower. Trigger was Friday's CPI report, hence that source. No official body declares a bear market.

real: Fed lifts rates 0.75 points, the most since 1994
anon: Central bank raises rates by the most in decades
note: Three-quarter-point rise, the largest since 1994.

real: US inflation hits 9.1%, the highest since 1981
anon: Prices rise at the fastest pace in a generation
note: June CPI, 12-month rise 9.1%.

real: Fed raises rates 0.75 points again, hints at a slowdown
anon: Central bank makes another big rate rise
note: Second 0.75 rise in a row; Powell signalled slower rises ahead at the press conference. Stocks rose.

real: US economy shrinks for a second quarter in a row
anon: The economy shrinks for a second quarter in a row
note: Advance estimate: GDP -0.9% annualised. Two negative quarters is a common rule of thumb for recession, not an official call.

real: US inflation eases to 8.5% as gas prices drop
anon: Price rises ease a little as fuel gets cheaper
note: July CPI, 12-month rise 8.5%, down from 9.1%. Stocks rose.

real: Powell warns rate rises will bring some pain
anon: Central bank chief warns that rate rises will cause pain
note: Jackson Hole speech, 10am ET; said higher rates will bring "some pain to households and businesses".

real: Hot inflation data sends stocks to the year's worst day
anon: Prices stay high; stocks have their worst day this year
note: August CPI 8.3%, core up more than expected. Close -4.32% in file; largest fall so far in 2022 in the file.

real: Fed raises rates 0.75 points for a third time in a row
anon: Central bank makes a third big rate rise in a row
note: Third consecutive 0.75 rise.

real: UK unveils big tax cuts and the pound plunges
anon: A big economy unveils tax cuts and its currency plunges
note: Growth Plan statement to Parliament Fri 23 Sep; sterling fell sharply that day and hit a record low vs the dollar on Mon 26 Sep.

real: Bank of England steps in to calm a bond market rout
anon: Officials step in to calm a government debt panic
note: Temporary purchases of long-dated gilts announced Wed 28 Sep.

real: US inflation hits 8.2% but stocks swing to end higher
anon: Prices stay high, yet stocks swing wildly to end higher
note: September CPI 8.2%. Stocks fell at the open, then reversed to close up 2.6% in file.

real: Fed raises rates 0.75 points a fourth time in a row
anon: Central bank makes a fourth big rate rise in a row
note: Fourth consecutive 0.75 rise; Powell said the eventual peak would be higher than expected.

real: US inflation cools to 7.7%, and stocks jump
anon: Price rises cool more than hoped and stocks soar
note: October CPI 7.7%, below forecasts. Close +5.54% in file.

real: Crypto exchange FTX files for bankruptcy
anon: A huge digital-coin exchange files for bankruptcy
note: Chapter 11 filing on Fri 11 Nov (early ET). Source is the claims agent site for the case; page blocks bots so not fetched by script.

real: Powell: smaller rate rises could start in December
anon: Central bank chief hints smaller rate rises are near
note: Brookings speech, 1:30pm ET; said slowing the pace could come as soon as December. Stocks rose 3.09% in file.

real: Fed raises rates half a point and warns more is coming
anon: Central bank slows down but says more rises are coming
note: Half-point rise; projections showed higher peak rate. Statement at 2pm ET.

real: Fed raises rates a quarter point, slowing again
anon: Central bank slows again with a small rate rise
note: Quarter-point rise after a half-point in December.

real: Silicon Valley Bank fails and regulators take over
anon: A major tech lender fails and regulators step in
note: California regulator closed the bank on Fri 10 Mar; FDIC appointed receiver.

real: Over the weekend, US backs savers at two failed banks
anon: Over the weekend, officials back savers at failed banks
note: Joint Treasury, Fed, FDIC statement Sun 12 Mar protecting all depositors of Silicon Valley Bank and Signature Bank.

real: Swiss regulators back Credit Suisse after shares plunge
anon: Regulators back a big bank after its shares plunge
note: SNB and FINMA statement on Wed 15 Mar, issued after the shares plunged that day (late in European trading).

real: Over the weekend, UBS agrees to buy Credit Suisse
anon: Over the weekend, a rival rescues a struggling big bank
note: Deal announced Sun 19 Mar.

real: First Republic Bank is seized and sold to JPMorgan
anon: Regulators seize another lender and sell it to a rival
note: FDIC announced early Mon 1 May that California regulators had closed the bank and JPMorgan assumed all deposits (sale agreed over the preceding weekend).

real: Over the weekend, Biden signs the debt-limit deal
anon: Over the weekend, the president signs a debt-limit deal
note: Fiscal Responsibility Act (H.R. 3746) signed Sat 3 Jun.

real: Fed raises rates to the highest level in 22 years
anon: Central bank raises rates to their highest in years
note: Rise to 5.25-5.50%; highest since 2001.

real: After the close, Fitch cuts the US credit rating
anon: After the close, a rating agency downgrades the nation
note: Announced Tue 1 Aug after the close; AAA to AA+.

real: Fed signals interest rate cuts are coming next year
anon: Central bank signals rate cuts are coming next year
note: Held rates; projections showed cuts in 2024. Stocks rose.
